text:
The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic role analysis of the text "The firefighter raced into the burning building to rescue the trapped occupants, demonstrating true heroism":

*   **The firefighter**: Agent (the one performing the action of racing)
*   **raced**: Verb (the main action)
*   **into the burning building**: Location/Goal (where the racing was directed)
*   **to rescue the trapped occupants**: Purpose (the reason for racing)
    *   **to rescue**: Purpose verb
    *   **the trapped occupants**: Patient/Theme (the entity being rescued)
*   **demonstrating true heroism**: Manner/Result (how the action was perceived or what it signified)
    *   **demonstrating**: Participle verb
    *   **true heroism**: Theme (what was demonstrated)
